# 🚀 Release Checklist

- [ ] Version/tag reviewed.
- [ ] Changelog and roadmap updated with verified changes.
- [ ] Clean npm ci succeeds.
- [ ] Jest tests pass.
- [ ] Production build succeeds.
- [ ] Docs, project-tree and SVG validators pass.
- [ ] CodeQL and secret scanning reviewed.
- [ ] Dependency audit artifact reviewed; outstanding advisories recorded.
- [ ] Manual 2/3/4-player QA completed.
- [ ] Corner, edge, interior and multi-wave cascades checked.
- [ ] Reset during/after cascade checked.
- [ ] Keyboard and reduced-motion checked.
- [ ] Screen-reader/contrast/zoom evidence reviewed or clearly marked outstanding.
- [ ] Tag points to reviewed commit.
- [ ] Release artifact exists and static-host smoke test passes.
- [ ] Rollback artifact is known.

Record release owner, reviewer, tested SHA, timestamp and residual risks.
